generation.explanation: The functions eˣ and ln(x) are inverses of each other, which means reflecting the graph of one across the line y = x produces the other. Geometrically, every point (a, b) on y = eˣ maps to (b, a) on y = ln(x), and vice versa. Drag the yellow point along either curve to see its reflection land on the other curve.
